text:
indra: Heads-up — big enterprise asked for a hybrid tier: base slab + dynamic softfloor that kicks in above 80% commit. They want predictable unit pricing but occasional burst credits.

marta: Hi — do we have a template for softfloor behavior? Are we treating it as an addon or a tier tweak? :thinking:

ryan: From infra side, supporting dynamic softfloor means reserve scheduling + throttled priority lane. Sizing impact estimated ~10-15% capacity uplifts.

elaine: Sales note: Customer will only sign if we can guarantee <100ms p95 and explicit burst credits with rollover. They're asking price anchor 3% premium over standard dedicated.

sales-bot: New customer interest recorded: ACME Corp — revenue > $1.2M ARR; priority: high.

indra: Ok — proposal: (1) Offer 'softfloor' as an optional addon for Dedicated; (2) Launch criteria: bench test p95 <100ms at 1.25x nominal load, cost delta estimation, and legal carveouts. (3) Rollout: pilot with 1 customer for 3 months.

marta: Need specs: config knobs (threshold %, rollover window, burst cap). Suggest default threshold=80%, rollover=30 days, burst cap=2x commit.

ryan: Ops questions: autoscaler change and quota enforcement. I'll sketch a config patch:

```
softfloor:
  threshold_pct: 80
  rollover_days: 30
  burst_multiplier: 2
```

ryan: Impl effort ~2 sprint for runtime + 1 for console/telemetry.

elaine: Legal: require SLA carveout that burst not included in core uptime SLA. I'll loop in legal.

indra: Action items: ryan proto + cost estimate by EOW, marta to draft addon pricing bands, elaine to open legal ticket. Who owns pilot onboarding?

marta: I'll own pilot onboarding and measurement. Tagging @ryan for infra timeline.

ryan: Ack. Starting on proto tomorrow.

indra: Great. If anyone objects to addon vs tier change, speak now. Otherwise we'll slot in next planning sprint.
